doc.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Describing her style and wishing she had played only classical
summary: She calls herself a highly trained jazz classical pianist and would choose all classical if starting over.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: How do you describe your own piano style?
I don’t know. A highly-trained jazz classical pianist.
You said jazz first. Would you prefer them to be equal? How would you, if you had to do it all over again, how would you like to be as a piano player? What directions did you not take…
I think I would play all classical. ‘Cause then I wouldn’t have to think about the jazz and making a living. In classical, you have to fill the halls. It’s not just wanting to be a classical pianist.
